jobs.name: Compliance Audit
jobs.prompt: Execute security compliance audit for this namespace. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/compliance_audit_sop.md' and scan this namespace's workloads for deviations from corporate GKE security and network policies. You are read-only: file any remediation as a submit-suggestion PR, never mutate the namespace directly.

jobs.name: Standardization Validator
jobs.prompt: Run weekly structural alignment audit for this namespace. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/standardization_validator_sop.md' to perform deep-diff analysis between this namespace's live workload states and the corporate standards. You are read-only: propose corrections via submit-suggestion PRs.

jobs.name: Obtainability Audit
jobs.prompt: Execute dynamic capacity pool alignment audit for this namespace. Read '/opt/defaults/governance/obtainability_audit_sop.md' to identify rigid workload allocations in this namespace and generate YAML patches (as submit-suggestion PRs) to align with flexible capacity. You are read-only; you never apply patches directly.
